verdict.rationale: Cooley documents a labor and employment practice serving 3,000+ clients annually, including emerging growth companies. Its Cooley GO incorporation package generates an IP Assignment Agreement, but that agreement is tied to founder stock purchase, not employee hiring. None of the evidence explicitly names offer letters, employment agreements or employee invention-assignment/confidentiality agreements as deliverables. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of offer-letter and employment-agreement preparation, employee-level PIIA/confidentiality agreement templates or services, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm prepares hiring paperwork — offer letters, employment agreements, and invention-assignment/confidentiality agreements — as part of a documented employment practice

citations.quote: Serving 3,000+ clients annually across a diverse range of industries, including investment funds, emerging growth companies, large public companies, government contractors, senior management, boards of directors
Restricted Stock Purchase Agreement, which automatically includes an Assignment Agreement for intellectual property
